auth_details: API key as query parameter api_key on every request; free self-serve registration at the St. Louis Fed FRED site.
free_tier_limits: Free with API key; 120 requests/minute published rate limit (no paid tiers).
description: FRED is the St. Louis Fed's public API for economic time series. It exposes observations, series metadata, categories, releases, sources, and tags for thousands of U.S. and international indicators (GDP, CPI, unemployment, interest rates, and more). Developers query JSON or XML with an API key; responses support vintage dates, frequency aggregation, and unit transformations useful for analytics and research apps.
resolution_notes: Auditing rate limit claims against current official FRED docs.
